description:
Acceptable for type/wire crates but worth considering for:
- jmap-server (dispatcher hot path; ResultReference resolution)
- jmap-mime (parser; large messages)
- jmap-base-client (URL/JSON serde for session fetch)

Lower priority: not a publish blocker, just a lifecycle gap. Worth flagging because performance regressions in the dispatcher would be invisible until users complain.
